name: Stem Cell Biology and Regenerative Medicine Minor
intro: The Department of Stem Cell Biology and Regenerative Medicine at the Keck School of Medicine offers a minor in Stem Cell Biology and Regenerative Medicine. This minor provides focused course work in developmental biology, animal regeneration, stem cell science and regenerative medicine, as well as exposure to laboratory methods in stem cell science.
